_real_world.variant_scope: T700-GE-401C as fitted to MH-60R/MH-60S Seahawk (twin-engine installation)
public_equipment: 2 x T700-GE-401C, 1,890 shp maximum (10-min) rating (GE Aerospace datasheet)

_provenance.modeling_note: T700-GE-401C is a turboshaft (drives a rotor, not a thrust-producing propulsor); the loader's Engine block is thrust-in-newtons shaped with no shaft-horsepower field (src/content/unit_definition_loader.cpp only parses mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n/sfc_mil/sfc_ab/bypass_ratio). mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n is an engineering_estimate equivalent static thrust from the sourced 1,890 shp maximum rating via the same T[N]~=4.0*shp proxy factor used for the CSG turboprop engine records (CSG_US_T56-A-427A, CSG_US_T56-A-425); not a real thrust figure and not physically meaningful for a helicopter rotor drive. sfc_mil/sfc_ab use the GE datasheet's directly sourced Maximum(10-min) SFC figure, which is a genuine sourced value (unlike the thrust fields).

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: 1,890 shp Maximum(10-min) rating sourced from GE datasheet; converted via T[N]=4.0*shp proxy factor since the loader has no shp field and this is a rotor-drive turboshaft, not a thrust engine

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: set equal to mil_thrust_n; turboshaft has no afterburner stage

engine.sfc_mil.note: 0.462 lb/SHP-hr, Maximum(10-min) rating, GE Aerospace T700-401C/-701C datasheet AE-44022A

engine.sfc_ab.note: same GE datasheet Maximum(10-min) SFC figure; no distinct afterburner stage to differentiate

engine.bypass_ratio.note: 0.0 placeholder; not a meaningful concept for a turboshaft
